exposure: French National College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (CNGOF) guidelines
outcome: Inter-operator ObGyn agreement on CTG analysis
cohort: 100 women who underwent a first cesarean section for non-reassuring CTG
finding: While inter-operator agreement was low but fair overall, the FIGO guidelines for CTG analysis demonstrated higher reproducibility compared to CNGOF guidelines in determining the justification for first cesarean section.
